features.reach: Navigate directly to /; fetches WordPress page 18 and case studies via /wp-json proxy.
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs request GET / --contains "Nunziella" && node tools/control-nunziella.mjs browse --path / --record

features.reach: Navigate to /about; renders WordPress page 310, CV image preview gated by enableCvLivePreview, and PDF download link.
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs request GET /about --contains "about" && node tools/control-nunziella.mjs browse --path /about --record

features.reach: Navigate to /contact; submits form payload directly to WordPress Contact Form 7 and reports errors or latency spikes to /api/contact-alert.
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs request GET /contact --contains "contact" && node tools/control-nunziella.mjs browse --path /contact --record

features.feature: Contact form error & latency Discord alert API
features.reach: POST /api/contact-alert validates PII-free telemetry and dispatches Discord alerts on Contact Form 7 delivery failures or latency spikes.
actions: Dispatch Discord error or latency alert
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs request POST /api/contact-alert --status 400 --data '{}' --contains "Invalid alert kind"

features.reach: Navigate to /private (requires ENABLE_PRIVATE_CASE_STUDY_ROUTE !== false; shows password gate unless authenticated via login).
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs login && node tools/control-nunziella.mjs browse --path /private --record

features.feature: Dynamic case study & optional password gate
features.reach: Navigate to /<slug> (e.g. /fd-surgery); append ?preview_gate=1 to test gate UI on any slug, or login first for protected slugs.
Navigate to any unmatched path (e.g. /does-not-exist) to verify NotFound component.

features.feature: Case study edge password gate API
features.reach: GET /api/verify-access checks auth cookie; POST /api/verify-access validates CASE_STUDY_PASSWORD and sets HTTP-only cookie.
features.verify: node tools/control-nunziella.mjs login && node tools/control-nunziella.mjs request GET /api/verify-access --contains '"authenticated":true'

features.reach: GET /health; no auth or seed required.
actions: Inspect commit SHA and deploy status HTML

features.reach: GET /health.json; returns { ok, status, commitSha, deploy }.
actions: Verify live commit SHA against expected merge SHA
